vibe: Clean, simple, highly functional dashboard with soft blue accents, emphasizing trust and clarity.

layout_and_spacing.general: Dense but airy. Cardless rectangular approach with generous padding.
layout_and_spacing.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 md:py-12
layout_and_spacing.header: h-16 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-6
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm

components_strategy.tables: Use Shadcn Table. No internal vertical borders. Use hover:bg-slate-50 for rows.
components_strategy.buttons: Flat style with rounded-md. Primary: bg-blue-500 text-white. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Labels must be uppercase and small. Inputs must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 focus:border-blue-500.
components_strategy.badges: Status badges must use soft backgrounds with distinct text colors (e.g. bg-green-100 text-green-700 for Present).
components_strategy.login_page: Split screen layout: Left side clean white form, Right side generated abstract soft blue cinematic background.

motion.page_load: framer-motion opacity-0 to opacity-100 translate-y-2 to translate-y-0

icons.style: stroke-2, size 20px (w-5 h-5) for standard use

testing.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, table rows, and links must have a role-based kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., login-submit-button, member-table-row-1).

logo.description: Revival Baptist Church logo to be used in Header, Login Page, and Navigation.

login_background.description: Revival Baptist Church logo for the login page.

community_image.description: Optional image showing a bright church gathering.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement navigation either as a sticky top header or left sidebar using the provided logo.
For the Dashboard, provide 3 bold, clear action cards: Add Member, View Members, Take Attendance.
Implement Member Management using Shadcn Table for listing and a dialog/page for the Add/Edit form.
Implement Attendance System using a Shadcn Table with interactive Radio Group or Select for status marking.
Enforce the 'Clean Utility' font setup: Manrope for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not default to Inter.
Include Google Sheets integration logic as specified in the original request.
Strictly follow the color definitions from this JSON, limiting the soft blue accent primarily to actions and active states.
